resolutions.researcher_notes: Status=construction (DP4-Sabratha segment, part of the Bouri Gas Utilisation Project / BGUP) confirmed by inference across four independent outlets, none of which use the literal word 'construction' but all describe the project as mid-build, pre-commissioning: Offshore Magazine (ABL overseeing installation of platform modules, ongoing EPCIC scope of laying the 28 km DP3/DP4-Sabratha pipeline network); Offshore Engineer/oedigital (May 2026: fabrication 69% complete vs 62% planned, modules just shipped from Ravenna, platform tie-in and pipeline pre-commissioning still ahead); NOC Libya's own release (same 69%-vs-62% milestone, gas units installed on DP4 but production not yet started); and attaqa.net (Arabic, 2025-07-10: pipelines/platforms description with the project described as due to start operating 'next year' i.e. 2026, not yet in service). All are consistent with construction/pre-commissioning, not operating. Old current_ref links (nsenergybusiness ?cf-view and the 2025-02-04 attaqa.net piece) are both dead/unreachable; replaced with live sources above. DEAD_LINK class from the brief resolved via REFS_ADDED.

StartMonth1='2028' is not corroborated by any source found; the opposite is well documented. Five independent, current (2026) sources -- NOC Libya (noc.ly, two releases), Libya Herald, oedigital.com, and inspenet.com -- all state the Bouri Gas Utilisation Project (covering exactly this DP4-Sabratha segment) is 'on track'/'scheduled' to begin actual gas production in September 2026, with fabrication at 69% completion (vs. 62% planned) as of May 2026 and ~$928M of the $1.565B budget spent through December 2025. No source ties any 2028 date to this pipeline or the wider BGUP. This is consistent with the brief's flagged suspicion that '2028' is a miskey (e.g. of a September 2026 date, or a transposition) rather than a real value -- staging a source against the sheet's literal '2028' would misrepresent the evidence, so this is left UNRESOLVED for Baird/the sheet owner to correct rather than sourced as-is. If the intended value is corrected to 2026, strong replacement refs are ready: https://libyaherald.com/2026/05/mellitah-oil-gas-bouri-field-us-1-565-billion-gas-exploitation-project-completes-phase-to-start-utilising-125-million-cf-day-of-natural-gas-by-september and https://noc.ly/en/mellitah-finishes-bouri-field-gas-units-ahead-of-schedule/ (both verified live, both explicit on September 2026).

Diameter='10,4' in (multi-diameter) for the DP4-Sabratha segment matches nsenergybusiness.com's project page verbatim: '~20km long 10-inch CS and a 4-inch CS pipelines will connect DP4 Platform to Sabratah Platform to transfer dehydrated gas and condensate'. The current_ref URL (same domain, with a '?cf-view' query string) was dead; the same page without the query string is live and verified -- same underlying source, so REVERIFIED rather than REFS_ADDED. Could not find a second independent source stating both diameters together: oedigital.com, libyaherald.com, noc.ly and inspenet.com all independently corroborate the headline '10-inch, 20km' pipeline (rounding/simplifying away the parallel smaller line) but none mention the 4-inch condensate line specifically, so they don't fully corroborate the compound '10,4' value. Staged as medium/single-source per the tiering rule rather than left unresolved, since the one full match is a detailed, purpose-built project-spec page (not a wire-copy rehash).
